sections.overview: This speaker system was developed by the reference series craftsman who challenged the limit of quality and cost performance.The Coda7features an inverted Woofer and Tweeter layout and a unique arrangement of bass reflex ports.This decision was made based on the results of data verification after testing in all listening areas, and is advantageous in terms of sound quality, such as the sense of weight in the low range, the sense of speed in the high range, and the sense of overall balance.A 13cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Pulp and corn paper is used for the diaphragm, and by applying a doping agent, excellent low-frequency reproduction beyond the range of small speakers is realized.A 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The baffle surface equalizes the mass by blowing the material into the mold with gas pressure. description: Audio Database KEF Coda7 ¥ 16,500 (1 unit, sold in August 1995) Commentary This speaker system was developed by the reference series craftsman who challenged the limit of quality and cost performance. The Coda7 features an inverted Woofer and Tweeter layout and a unique arrangement of bass reflex ports. This decision was made based on the results of data verification after testing in all listening areas, and is advantageous in terms of sound quality, such as the sense of weight in the low range, the sense of speed in the high range, and the sense of overall balance. A 13 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. Pulp and corn paper is used for the diaphragm, and by applying a doping agent, excellent low-frequency reproduction beyond the range of small speakers is realized. A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range. The baffle surface equalizes the mass by blowing the material into the mold with gas pressure. It is lightweight, highly rigid, and firmly secures the unit to eliminate external vibration and mutual interference of each unit. The rear panel is molded by gas pressure in the same way as the front panel. Resonance is taken into consideration by equalizing the mass, and the design is loose even when high-quality cables are connected. The connector RUNNET is attached to the edge of the woofer and the edge of the bass reflex port. The hole for the connector RUNNET in the baffle surface is eliminated. This prevents the effect of the hole on the frequency characteristics and improves the design of the baffle surface. Speaker terminal compatible with banana plug is adopted. sections.overview:
45,000(1unit, around 1988)  43,000(1unit, around 1989)

The C-series bookshelf speaker system uses a passive radiator.It is equipped with a 20cm cone type passive radiator using polymer cone to increase the low-frequency reproduction capability.This unit uses a die-cast chassis.The unit is equipped with 20cmUNI Q driver, a coaxial type unit unique to KEF.This UNI-Q driver consists of a 20cm cone type woofer and a 1.9cm dome type tweeter. It is not only arranged coaxially but also arranged in the depth direction. In addition, the outer diameter of the cone of the woofer compensates for the directivity factor or Q of the tweeter so that both units have the same directivity in the crossover range.In order to realize the structure of the UNI-Q, a neodymium iron boron magnet with energy 10times that of ferrite is used in the magnetic circuit of the UNI-Q, and the size of the magnetic circuit of the UNI-Q is reduced, and the UNI-Q is housed in the voice coil of the woofer unit.A 3.2cm diameter voice coil and diecast chassis are used for the woofer part, and a polymer dome is used for the tweeter part.

sections.title: KEF MODEL103-4S
sections.overview: This is a tall boy type speaker system with a large scale expressive power in spite of its simple structure.A TCC (Twin Coupled Cavity) system using two 20cm cone type woofers is adopted to enhance the low-frequency reproduction capability.This system employs a structure in which two woofers are mounted horizontally and vertically inside the enclosure. By twin-driving the woofers, natural deep bass sound is emitted instantaneously from a low-frequency port called an air diaphragm.This structure looks similar to the bass reflex method, but the operation principle is different. In the bass reflex method, the resonance effect is used to increase the quantitative bass sensation, so it tends to be played back as sound after being delayed by one wavelength, or the bass expression tends to be wrapped around regardless of the musical tone. In the TCC system, the top and bottom horizontal woofers each have a sealed cavity, and an air diaphragm is arranged in an intermediate space between the woofers, so that the air layer acts as an effective load against the movement of the woofer and achieves high efficiency.In addition, the magnets of the two woofers are connected to each other by a special rod. This not only serves as a four scan cell to prevent delayed resonance, which causes congestion, but also converts the force given by the two upper and lower magnetic circuits into acoustic energy.This TCC system prevents the cancellation phenomenon that occurs when the phase of the unit and the duct are opposite to each other below the resonance frequency that occurs with the bass reflex system.A coaxial unit UNI-Q driver composed of a 16cm cone type unit and a 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the middle and high area.The UNI-Q Driver is different from the coaxial unit which is unified only on the plane. In order to achieve a single sound in the depth direction, the structure in which the acoustic centers of two units, a tweeter and a driver, are completely overlapped is adopted.In order to realize this UNI-Q structure, a new magnetic material, neodymium iron boron, which has 10times the energy of ferrite, is used for the magnetic circuit of the tweeter, and the magnetic circuit of the miniaturized tweeter is superimposed inside the voice coil of the low frequency unit.It uses a CLM mechanism to convert irregular and complex speaker impedance into an infinitely flat resistance value over the audible frequency band.High compression MDF with sufficient mass and moderate internal losses is used in the baffle area where the unit is mounted, and the exterior of the enclosure has a walnut finish with a symmetrically grained wood veneer.The characteristics of the left-right pair unit and the right-left pair network are strictly controlled by a computer, and the sound pressure level is kept within 0.5dB for both left and right.It uses a separate type input terminal for bi-amplifier connection.Removable spike and spike cover can be equipped.

sections.title: KEF MODEL104
sections.overview:
A reference series speaker system developed based on the latest research results.The model104uses a heat-resistant voice coil spirally wound around the voice coil assembly and a short coil finished with epoxy resin. It achieves heat resistance of at least 250? for short time use and 180? for continuous use.This improves the durability of the speaker unit and reduces problems caused by failure.The low range features a 20cm cone woofer (B200/SP1039) and a 32x21cm passive radiator (Dron cone) (BD139/SP1037), enabling low sound playback up to 30Hz with higher efficiency than driving a single large diaphragm.The Woofer Unit B200/SP1039is equipped with a PVC (Polyester Voice Coil), a heat-resistant driving mechanism consisting of an electrically and mechanically combined voice coil and magnet assembly, as well as a strene diaphragm made of New Visco Elastic Body Dump.The passive radiator BD139/SP1037was developed from the world-famous B139bass unit.This radiator is driven by the low-temperature energy from the back of the B200to compensate for the low-temperature output, thereby expanding the low-range, increasing efficiency and reducing distortion.The sandwich-type diaphragm is finely tuned and housed in an aluminum die-cast frame.The T27/SP1032dome type tweeter is mounted in the high range.This unit consists of a pressure-molded Melinex dome part and roll edge part.The network section is equipped with 6-element DN15/SP1041.The network has a roll-off slope of 18dB/8ve at 3kHz, divides the sound domain into two parts, and uses carefully selected stable components and low-loss capacitors for critical parts.An acoustic control is mounted on the back of the grill so that the response of the speaker can be adjusted according to the shape of the room.This control allows you to adjust the response characteristics of the middle range in three ways.To prevent resonance, the enclosure uses dense structural material, strong internal fixing material, sound absorbing moisture-proof material, and special interior material for resonance prevention.It is equipped with a grill with special mesh on the front.It is designed to protect the drilling diaphragm without losing sound quality, and the high-frequency attenuation is limited to less than 1dB up to 20kHz.

The group presented at London AES a new measurement method using digital computers that contributed to the development of the Model104.In the development of Model104, Fourier analysis using digital computer was introduced.This evaluation method was presented by L. R. Finchum (then principal researcher at KEF Electronics Limited) and R. V. Ledam (then Audio Group at Bradford University) at the Audio Engineering Society held in London on February 13, 1973.

sections.title: KEF MODEL105-3S
sections.overview: This is a tall boy type speaker system developed with the latest know-how while inheriting the genealogy of the long-selling Model 105.A TCC (Twin Coupled Cavity) system using two 20cm cone type woofers is adopted to enhance the low-frequency reproduction capability.This system employs a structure in which two woofers are mounted horizontally and vertically inside the enclosure. By twin-driving the woofers, natural deep bass sound is emitted instantaneously from a low-frequency port called an air diaphragm.This structure looks similar to the bass reflex method, but the operation principle is different. In the bass reflex method, the resonance effect is used to increase the quantitative bass sensation, so it tends to be played back as sound after being delayed by one wavelength, or the bass expression tends to be wrapped around regardless of the musical tone. In the TCC system, the top and bottom horizontal woofers each have a sealed cavity, and an air diaphragm is arranged in an intermediate space between the woofers, so that the air layer acts as an effective load against the movement of the woofer and achieves high efficiency.In addition, the magnets of the two woofers are connected to each other by a special rod. This not only serves as a four scan cell to prevent delayed resonance, which causes congestion, but also converts the force given by the two upper and lower magnetic circuits into acoustic energy.This TCC system prevents the cancellation phenomenon that occurs when the phase of the unit and the duct are opposite to each other below the resonance frequency that occurs with the bass reflex system.Two 16cm cone type mid-bass woofers with polypropylene diaphragm are mounted for the mid-low range.A coaxial unit UNI-Q driver composed of a 16cm cone type unit and a 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the middle and high area.The UNI-Q Driver is different from the coaxial unit which is unified only on the plane. In order to achieve a single sound in the depth direction, the structure in which the acoustic centers of two units, a tweeter and a driver, are completely overlapped is adopted.In order to realize this UNI-Q structure, a new magnetic material, neodymium iron boron, which has 10times the energy of ferrite, is used for the magnetic circuit of the tweeter, and the magnetic circuit of the miniaturized tweeter is superimposed inside the voice coil of the low frequency unit.The unit layout is a vertical twin system with a UNI-Q driver installed in the center and a low-frequency unit mounted on the top and bottom, so that all sound sources coincide at the same point in space and a clear sound image is obtained over the entire frequency band.The UNI-Q driver and Twin Drive midbus woofer are mounted with a 75mm thick baffle block hollowed out. This baffle block is equipped with a high-compression chipboard MDF that is designed not to have a specific resonance frequency. Moreover, it is designed to be semi-floating from the enclosure to block unwanted vibrations from the enclosure, which adversely affect sound quality.In addition, the back of each unit is separated by an aluminum diecast cover called a pot to prevent mutual interference.KEF'Ωs unique Conjugate Load Matching (CLM) mechanism converts irregular and complex impedance into an infinitely flat resistance value over the audible frequency band, ensuring stable sound quality under all conditions.The enclosure is made of 22mm thick material, and the interior has a thorough vibration isolation structure that eliminates unnecessary resonance.In addition, the exterior is finished with a beautiful walnut wood finish in which the wood grain is symmetrically matched by slicing a single veneer.The pair characteristics of each unit are strictly controlled by a computer, and the L/R difference is kept within 0.5dB.In addition, a separate large input terminal is mounted for bi-amplifier drive.The legs can be equipped with removable spikes and spike covers.

sections.title: KEF RDM-1
sections.overview: This is a small speaker system of the RDM series that combines the monitor speaker technology that KEF has developed over many years with the latest UNI-Q tech Leptodora kindtii.The unit is equipped with a 16cm coaxial type unit which is a fourth generation UNI-Q driver.This unit has a coaxial structure consisting of a 16cm cone wide-range woofer and a 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter made of pure silk material, and realizes sound image localization with excellent phase characteristics.In the fourth generation UNI-Q driver, the voice coil is a long-through type in order to achieve power handling and low frequency tightness that can withstand monitor speaker specifications. The voice coil is set longer than the conventional type to give sufficient linearity even for large actions with large input and long stroke, and the voice coil is designed to dynamically reproduce a strong low frequency range.Furthermore, by taking advantage of the large diameter tweeter and reducing the crossover to 2.1kHz, effective tuning for low-frequency reproduction is achieved.Consideration is also given to the effect of the vibration of the woofer on the radiation of the tweeter.The network section is designed to solve the problems of phase variation at the crossover point and modulation to each band. sections.title: KEF REFERENCEMODEL1
sections.overview: A toll-boy type speaker system that adopts UNI-Q driver and SCC system.The low-frequency band adopts the SCC (Single Coupled Cavity) system, an original interport bus system.This system is the basic form of the TCC system adopted in Reference Model 2, Model 3and Model 4. In Reference Model1, a cavity and a 16cm pulp cone type woofer B160are placed in the lower part of the cabinet, and the interport for tuning the frequency is grounded so that a straight and slightly low sound can be obtained.16cmUNI Q driver, KEF'Ωs unique coaxial type unit, is installed in the middle and high frequency ranges.This unit uses MB160for the cone woofer and NT25for the soft dome tweeter. In addition to the coaxial structure, the diaphragm is positioned at the same point in the depth direction so that the center of the sound is completely overlapped. This realizes a single sound source that matches in all points of time, space, and directivity. In order to realize this structure, the Tweeter NT25uses neodymium iron boron, which has 10times the magnetic force of ferrite, and succeeded in miniaturization of the magnetic circuit.In the new reference series, pure silk is used for the tweeter diaphragm to improve sound connection.The network section is designed based on an original computer data analysis.In addition, oxygen-free copper wire is used for the wiring material to enable high-purity transmission.The UNI-Q driver is laid out on the upper part to prevent the influence of the baffle surface from interfering with the sound field spreading. This reduces distortion and improves sound spread, sound field feeling and phase characteristics.In addition, in order to reduce the influence of mutual interference between units and unnecessary vibration from the outside, a new material HDSP (High Density Structural Polymer) is used for the baffle surface, which is excellent in vibration control and has very dead acoustic characteristics. Moreover, for this material, each unit is semi-floating processed with vibration absorbing rubber material between them, and the screw stopper is decoupled structure with vibration absorbing material to eliminate the influence of cabinet vibration.In addition, considering the effect of the edge of the speaker on sound, the whole is finished in a streamlined ergo design.The bottom of the cabinet uses the same HDSP as the material used to fix the speaker unit, so as to stabilize the whole system and eliminate interference to sound caused by external vibration.The exterior features a Rosetta Bar Finish featuring Italian-style wood grain.The rear terminal is made of strong brass cast into a mold and gold-plated.You can also use a banana plug for bi-wiring and bi-amplifier.The legs are equipped with a gold-plated brass insulator.In addition, the core of the legs can be inverted to form spikes, and the length can be adjusted according to the condition of the floor surface.The left and right characteristics are strictly controlled and tuned from the stage of the unit, and the error is kept within   0.5db.In addition, each speaker is managed and manufactured by a single skilled worker from the selection of materials, processing, assembly, soldering, wiring, and product inspection. All the work is done manually to achieve high quality.

In addition, the left and right power supply sections are also separated to prevent slight interference between the left and right channels and deterioration of sound quality due to interference at the power supply section.The circuit design is simple : the phono inputs pass through the equalizer amplifier and the flat amplifier, and the high-level inputs pass through the flat amplifier only.The input source is also limited to the minimum necessary.Both the equalizer amplifier and the flat amplifier have a simple design consisting of a minimum number of devices, rather than a complex circuit using a lot of transistors and ICs.However, the elements used are strictly selected, not only the level control and switches, but also the best ones including the small internal parts.To prevent the output signal from deteriorating before it is sent to the power amplifier, the output impedance of the pre-out and tape-out is kept as low as 10 .This low-impedance output reduces signal degradation.

description: Audio Database KRELL PAM-2 ¥ 830,000 (released in 1980) Commentary A preamplifier that eliminates complex circuits and faithfully amplifies the input source and feeds it to a power amplifier. The PAM-2 has a dual-mono configuration in which two monaural preamplifiers, all of which are completely independent, including not only the circuit but also the level control and input selector, are contained in one chassis. For this reason, the panel is equipped with two monaural level controllers, two input selectors and two tape monitor switches. In addition, the left and right power supply sections are also separated to prevent slight interference between the left and right channels and deterioration of sound quality due to interference at the power supply section. The circuit design is simple : the phono inputs pass through the equalizer amplifier and the flat amplifier, and the high-level inputs pass through the flat amplifier only. The input source is also limited to the minimum necessary. Both the equalizer amplifier and the flat amplifier have a simple design consisting of a minimum number of devices, rather than a complex circuit using a lot of transistors and ICs. However, the elements used are strictly selected, not only the level control and switches, but also the best ones including the small internal parts. To prevent the output signal from deteriorating before it is sent to the power amplifier, the output impedance of the pre-out and tape-out is kept as low as 10 Ω. This low-impedance output reduces signal degradation. description: Audio Database KRELL KAS * Released in 1993 ¥ 6,900,000 (a set of two cars, around 1994) Commentary A monaural power amplifier designed with the utmost wisdom to obtain pure power under all conditions and to increase signal purity as much as possible. KAS stands for Krell Audio Standard. サスティーンド Pre-to-Bias Technology for high-power, pure Class A operation that has been difficult to achieve due to power and heat issues. The circuit uses five input bias levels to eliminate heat and power issues. We have also developed and introduced a unique アンティシペーター circuit that senses input at a high speed of approximately 200 times (1,800 V / μ sec) of music signals and sets the bias, thereby preventing the speed of the bias setting from affecting the instantaneous rise of sound. Moreover, by maintaining the set bias voltage for a certain period of time after that even if no signal is input, the response instability due to constant bias fluctuation is eliminated. The amplifier section is equipped with 48 TO-3 can-type output transistors with specifications specified by the Kroell, which were produced in cooperation with Motorola. The power supply section is equipped with 48 regulator transistors of the same type to fully drive these transistors. With this unusual configuration in which one device is regulated by one device, extremely stable voltage and current are supplied to each stage of the amplifier section, and pure class A operation is realized even at the maximum output of 1 Ω load. In order to solve this problem, KAS has adopted a newly developed アンティシペーター circuit that is used in the amplifier section. It senses both input level and output impedance, and raises the voltage in advance in preparation for supply. This realizes an excellent start-up that cannot be achieved with conventional stabilized power supplies. sections.title: KRELL KMA-100
sections.overview:
1,350,000(1set of 2, released in 1983)

This monaural power amplifier was developed based on the KSA-100to further explore its potential.The basic circuit system is inherited almost as it is from the KSA-100, a stereo unit.Pure A-Class operation is adopted, which in principle does not cause switching distortion or crossover distortion. Pure complimentary service circuit with perfect symmetrical operation is adopted in the circuit structure. For example, not only the simple amount of harmonic distortion components, but also the appearance of the distortion mode, which has a large effect on audibility, is taken into consideration when selecting the circuit. In addition, NFB is limited to 15dB or less, and dynamic characteristics are emphasized so that dynamic distortion does not occur.In the power block, heat radiation fins and quiet cooling fans are combined, and heat generation in pure A class operation is coped with and thermal distortion is suppressed by strict temperature control of 75to 80degrees Celsius.The power supply unit has a larger capacity than that of the KSA-100in the space obtained by monaural conversion.It uses two separate power supply systems for the pre-driver stage and output stage. The power supply for the output stage is equipped with a 160,000? F capacitor, which is twice the size of the stereo KSA-100, and a 1.1kW-class large toroidal transformer with excellent regulation.Equipped with a terminal for BTL connection, BTL drive using two KMA-100units for one channel is possible.The KMA-100can produce almost four times the output power, as calculated, while most amplifiers can produce only about three times the output power when connected to a BTL.

sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier that is the top-of-the-line of the Kroell full power balance series.Equipped with Sustaine-Plateau Bias II.This circuit is a combination of a predictive sensor circuit that monitors all operational states of the amplifier over a wide range, such as the actual load applied to the output stage, and a bias setting circuit with a unique shift schedule. It realizes an ideal class A operation.The circuit configuration consists of a fully balanced differential circuit for all stages from input to output.The input gain stage amplifier is a current-mode amplifier that operates with the current between the inverting amplifier and the non-inverting amplifier. In addition, the precise gain matching between each amplifier is achieved by means of a unique microcontroller control. This realizes a high-precision balance drive. This cancels the negative influence on the ground line of the amplifier due to the reactive load when the speaker is actually driven, as well as the mutual interference of each stage around the ground line, and ensures excellent drive performance under all conditions.For the KAS (Kroell Audio Standard), which is a reference model of Kroell power amplifier, a metal can-type special product jointly developed with Motorola has been fully adopted.In addition, the fully regulated power stage provides a highly stable power supply from a constant voltage power supply to not only the first stage to the driver stage but also to the output stage. It constantly monitors the drive current and load of the output stage of the amplifier and instantaneously supplies the required voltage according to changes in the current.The Model600uses 14Pc250W class large capacity power transistors.Equipped with a full auto-calibration function, the amplifier automatically optimizes itself by self-evaluating the internal electrical adjustment conditions such as output bias, regulator voltage, and DC offset.On the production line, internal parameters are carefully checked for each unit, and the results are stored in the amplifier. In actual use, all operating conditions, including AC voltage, are monitored as needed to ensure accurate calibration of each unit and proper selection of the plateau level of Sustaine-Plateau Bias II. This feature provides long-term factory performance.In the event of an abnormal situation such as oscillation, DC leak, or short circuit of output terminal, the power supply is cut off immediately. This ensures high safety while eliminating common protective circuits such as relays and fuses, enabling direct connection between output stage and speakers.

sections.title: KYOCERA DA-7CX
sections.overview:
Based on Kyocera'Ωs non-resonance philosophy cultivated in the 910series, this CD player has been made more completely non-resonance.Capacitors and transistors in operation cause the microphonic effect, which converts external vibrations into electrical signals. On the other hand, electric signals can be converted into vibrations in servo circuits and power supplies, which are subject to sudden changes in current or large currents.The DA-7CX employs a fine-ceramic spacer with excellent rigidity, heat resistance, and vibration damping characteristics to eliminate the adverse effects of these vibrations. The fine-ceramic spacers are installed in eight locations. First, they are used to support the joints between the chassis and the board in areas most susceptible to vibrations, such as power supplies, servo amplifiers, signal processing circuits, output amplifiers, and D/A converters. In addition, the spacers are also used on the feet of the body to prevent acoustic feedback and body squeals.In order to reduce resonance and unnecessary vibration of the mechanical deck, we have adopted an outsert technology, which forms a complex structure by sandwiching a base material when resin is press-molded. Two different materials enhance the damping effect.In order to reduce vibration in the low range and shock from the outside, 3D (3point differential) suspension is adopted.Two points on the front panel side are supported by a rigid 3-way flexible damper, and one point on the rear side is floated by a soft spring. This prevents not only shock from the front panel but also vibration in the vertical direction.In addition, the 3-point support has the advantage of not losing balance even when the pickup is moved.

          The digital section'Ωs printed circuit board is designed using a CAD system. This allows for a fine pattern with a 0.3mm pitch. Furthermore, by using a photoplotter in conjunction with the design, we have achieved an excellent printed circuit board with sharp lines and little leakage or etching defects.
          The density of the parts is also close to the limit of single-sided mounting boards, and loops are kept small, reducing noise jumping and interference between parts.
          In addition, the GND is also completely separated for noisy areas, high-frequency systems, and areas with rapid current changes, preventing adverse effects and interference between each section.

          The analog part is completely separated from the digital part to improve sound quality.Only 14lines are connected to the digital section at two locations, creating a simple structure without any unnecessary parts or sections. The circuit is designed with full L/R complimentary service and the line amplifier section uses high-speed, high-output linear ICs.In addition, it employs a unique analytical sampling and holding technology and aperture collection circuit.The digital, analog and display sections use independent power supplies with different windings, especially the analog section uses a low-noise, low-impedance type power supply, which increases the advantage of three independent power supplies that reduce interference between circuits.The D/A converter that converts digital signals into analog signals uses a 16-bit high-speed integration type.High-speed and high-precision D/A conversion is achieved by adopting a low-noise FET-input high-through-rate linear IC for the integration circuit.The pickup unit uses a 3-beam tracking system, and the DA-7CX uses a unique focusing hold system. This ensures that even if data is lost due to a disk failure, the point of the previous data is held reliably and the focus returns quickly.We use superior wire materials such as LC-OFC and OFC, as well as high-grade electrolytic capacitors mixed with ceramic powder, copper-copper styrene capacitors, copper-copper polypropylene capacitors, and ceramic powder.In particular, wire materials are used after repeated audibility tests.Low distortion rate passive low-pass filter using LC-OFC and tough pitch copper for internal wiring is adopted.Equipped with a spindle brake system that opens the tray after the disk has completely stopped.Equipped with an independent headphone amplifier.A 14-segment 8-digit display using FL tubes has been adopted for the display part.Equipped with 10keys for direct control.It is equipped with functions such as 3-mode search function, repeat function, program memory of up to 16songs, and remaining time function which displays remaining time."CHK DISK" will appear on the display if the CD is loaded with a check disk function and there is a problem that the player cannot read.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: KYOCERA DA-910
sections.overview: A CD player developed based on the concept that music information on CDs can be changed into sound without losing it.In order to reduce the effects of external vibrations, we have adopted a new material, CCR, which is a compound of fine ceramic and resin, for the base chassis that supports the main body. This material has high rigidity, moderate internal loss, and excellent vibration damping characteristics. In the DA-910, main parts such as circuit boards, power transformers, and condensers are directly attached to the base chassis, eliminating most of the sources of internal vibrations.In addition, a foot with height adjustment that can be fixed rigidly to the floor surface has been adopted to realize an extremely high structure against external vibration.In addition, delicate analog circuits are covered by the FCL module to provide a shielding effect against pulse noise leaking from the display and servo circuit, and to prevent thermal distortion of elements and parts.The digital circuit uses a DA conversion system with digital filters and L/R-independent DA converters.The DA 910raises the frequency of the PCM signal by a factor of four (176.4kHz) and eliminates unwanted signals between 20kHz and 156.4kHz with a digital filter. After DA conversion, a low-order analog low-pass filter with a gentle slope is used to extract the music signal without deteriorating the phase and group delay characteristics.The DA 910is designed to simplify the signal path. First of all, the DA converter and subsequent parts are made non-contact, and the muting relay and output volume of the output are eliminated to reduce the adverse effect on sound quality. In addition, a discrete DC amplifier configuration is adopted in which the DA converter and the output terminal are directly connected. This improves the low-frequency phase characteristics and stabilizes the amplifier operation by the DC servo.In addition, the analog and digital power supplies are separated to eliminate the influence of digital noise leaking from the servo circuits in the display and optical sections.LC-OFC, which has been specially ordered by Kyocera for audio use, is used for signal wiring. LC-OFC has a feature that the number of crystal boundaries is much smaller than that of normal OFC, and it reduces degradation of music signal by boundary layer.We also use carefully selected parts, such as gold-plated connectors for contacts between boards and high-capacity (15A) power cords with polarity indication.A special alloy die cast with high rigidity is used for the head mechanism part.The parts after the DA converter are completely non-magnetic.It is equipped with functions such as index search, program memory of up to 20songs, repeat, memory skip, pause, memory call and remaining time display.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed under the theme of reproducing digital sound with maximum freshness.In order to simplify the transmission path, it is equipped with a unique DIOS (Direct In &ΩOut System).In addition to the normal input, there is also a direct in position. The program source connected to this input is input to the volume through the LC-OFC shield line and sent to the power amplifier. Unlike a conventional bypass (line direct) switch, it does not pass through any circuit boards or contacts before the volume, thus providing a simpler path.In addition, the A-710has a Direct out jack that eliminates the output relay, which can adversely affect sound quality, and provides a complete direct output that eliminates the speaker selector switch and associated wire routing.A unique CCR base chassis is used at the bottom of the amplifier. This chassis has an extremely rigid structure composed of a resin and fine ceramic compound, and has excellent vibration damping characteristics.Main parts and circuit boards are directly attached to this base chassis, and a foot with height adjustment that can be fixed to the bottom with a rigid structure reduces harmful vibrations from both external and internal sources.The power supply section is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a 22,000? F electrolytic capacitor, providing enough power margin to drive the speaker even with a 1  load for instantaneous operation.In addition, a dedicated power supply circuit is used for the equalizer amplifier to prevent interference from the power amplifier.It uses audio parts that have been carefully examined in terms of physical characteristics and audibility.In addition to the ultra-low-noise FET used for the equalizer amplifier, the MOS-FET driver for the power amplifier, high-grade copper and styrene capacitors for each line, ceramic electrolytic capacitors, and dip mica capacitors are used. In addition, tough pitch copper / OFC/LC-OFC wires are used in the right place after repeated hearing tests.There is no protective relay or output muting relay for the speaker outputs such as the Direct out jack or normal output jack. This is based on the idea that the relay itself has a strong magnetic field and generates noise when operating, and that the push-type contact is not sufficient for the current that drives the speaker, which causes sound quality degradation.In place of the output relay, the A-710uses a unique protection circuit that cuts off the output in the event of abnormal operation using circuit techniques. In this circuit, a limiter operates to protect the amplifier in the event of overload. In addition, the power supply to the power amplifier section is cut off, and in combination with a fuse, it protects the speaker and amplifier in three layers.In addition, when the power is turned on, the 4-point switches with different timings are turned on one after another to fade in to the specified volume, so that clipping does not occur and clear sound quality is obtained.On the input side, the Phono/Line operates an input muting relay for 7seconds when the power is turned on to prevent excessive volume and abnormal operation of the amplifier.In the case of direct in input, it does not pass through the input muting relay. However, when the power supply is turned ON/OFF, an auto fade-in / fade-out circuit automatically operates to protect the amplifier and speakers.Symmetrical design with consideration of signal flow and effects of vibration and heat. Main amplifier section is fully twin-mono configuration.It has a built-in MC transformer with repeated audibility tests to ensure the best match with the amplifier.High/Low2position MC cartridge load switching is also possible.The tone control section can switch the turnover frequency.Equipped with two tape inputs, especially designed to give priority to Tape1, and OFC and LC-OFC are used for signal transmission.Gold plated cutting type input connector is used.Large capacity power cord is used.The side wood does not use vinyl or resin, and has an oil finish that makes use of the texture of the wood.
